question: Does a small new MAX head learn more efficiently from a mature raw-frame receiver's actual hidden computation than from fixed random nonlinear features or an information-preserving raw projection?

provenance.U: User mature-network reuse, growing small branches, and permitted temporary regression/recovery concepts
provenance.F: Existing PR130 demand receivers and original Fable W candidate frame profile; PR131 identified missing lateral reuse but is not rerun
provenance.A: This fixed MAX readout, three equal-head feature conditions, fresh unordered split and accounting
provenance.T: No experimental training or model inference at preparation; actual execution receipts follow separately

source.frozen_reason: Causal feature-bank control only; not a claim that future adaptation must freeze the parent or never regress

task.name: fixed_MAX_readout
task.input: Actual source-profile n7 frame,34rawbits; Fable W candidate,not formal canonical SLE
task.opcode_role: Nuisance variation for this fixed MAX head; original operation meanings remain unchanged
task.external_task_identity: Experiment caller selects the MAX readout; no learned new-opcode detection or task router
task.output_scope: Seven answer bits, not a complete canonical SLE response or a newly assigned formal MAX opcode
task.teacher_scope: True operands generate supervised MAX labels only. No true operands, MAX answers, source-oracle answers, or test outcomes enter feature inputs.
task.source_output_scope: Mature hidden activations are actual frozen-model computations. Full source predictions may be audited after all training; they are not replaced by truth or fed as MAX labels.

data.split_rule: Sort unordered groups, permute unequal groups then ties using one RNG. Non-equal groups: 1024train/256val/384test/117unused; ties12/12/12. Expand both directions when unequal and all4opcodes within the same split.
data.exclusions: Both directions must be in source unused; exclude all source old/new train,val,test unordered groups, including source growth-selection validation.
data.new_test_features: No test feature generation, source prediction, normalization fitting, or head prediction until all nine heads have completed all4096updates.
data.benchmark_scope: Fresh held semantic pairs within the bounded n7 source domain, including both operand orders and held ties; not unbounded arithmetic or unseen numeric vocabulary.

arms.mature_hidden: tanh(raw34 @ source.W1 + source.b1), using actual PR130 weights
arms.random_hidden: Same34to24tanh architecture, fixed Xavier-normal W1 andzero b1; seed1800000+seed
arms.raw_projection: Fixed34x24 affine map;18 variable rows form an orthonormal basis,constant rowszero. Preserves all input differences in the variable-coordinate subspace. StoredP,bias authoritative.

features.normalization: For each arm/seed, fit mean24 on train features, then one global RMS scalar sqrt(mean((f-mean)^2)), floor1e-8. Val/test use frozen train statistics.25fixednumbers. Raw singular values shareone common rescaling,condition1 maintained.
features.raw_projection_prior: Constant-coordinate removal uses unlabeled train frame variation and the declared fixed n7 layout; no operand values are parsed or provided to the head.
features.cache: Compute and save train/validation features once per arm/seed; test only after all training. Count actual feature rows and cache storage, plus per-query deployment feature cost.

head.initialization: Paired per seed across all arms: seed1900000+seed; W1normalstdsqrt(2/32), W2normalstdsqrt(2/15), zero biases
head.output: Seven logits threshold>=0; primary correctness requires all seven bits correct
head.architecture_search: None; H8 fixed, no adaptive growth, no H sweep

training.batch_rule: Same saved4096x128indices per seed across all arms; replacement sampling from fresh train frames
training.loss: Mean binary cross entropy over all seven output bits and all rows
training.stopping: Always4096, regardless of95threshold, regressions, or poor scores. No reseeding, test-tuned repair, or curriculum adjustment.
training.execution: One automated loop; source-lock check before and after; no LLM choices inside updates

metrics.primary: Validation exact seven-bit MAX accuracy by seed/checkpoint; first observed95%; first checkpoint ending two consecutive observed evaluations>=95%; final fresh test exactaccuracy
metrics.secondary: AUC of validation exactaccuracy over update count using trapezoids at fixed checkpoints; opcode/operand-order/tie strata; copy-a/copy-b baselines; all errors retained; one final all-train exactaccuracy evaluation after all9headsfinish using cached trainfeatures, never a continuation criterion
metrics.threshold_note: 95% markers do not stop or promote based on test. Missing crossing remains null; continuous safety or every-update monotonicity not required.
metrics.source_audit: After all training, decode mature source on fresh test from actual cached hidden and retained readout; report source tuple correctness and head errors by source correctness. No truth substitution.
metrics.comparison_claim: Matched new-head capacity and data; full-system storage differs because mature source retains its original450parameter readout. Conditional additional learning efficiency, not training-from-scratch total cost superiority.

accounting.dense_note: Raw zero rows are stored and still counted by the dense implementation; rawP432nonzero+bias24. Tanh,normalization,backprop,Adam,evaluation,IO excluded from dense MAC and reported separately.
accounting.inherited_search_cost_note: These are the chosen source lineages only, not all historical project experiments.

constraints: No changes to source artifacts or other experiments
All failure cases and temporary regressions retained
